speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying that. To help me understand the pattern better, has this specific behavior towards your teacher and dad been present for at least six months?

speaker: Doctor
text: It sounds like this is a persistent pattern of argumentative and defiant behavior toward specific authority figures. To confirm the diagnosis, do you experience any significant distress or impairment in your social or academic functioning because of these interactions?

speaker: Patient
text: My grades are fine because I do the work when I want to, and my friends still like hanging out with me. I don't really feel upset about the trouble, I just wish my teacher would stop being so strict.

speaker: Doctor
